title: Man with Toddler in Garden, 1930s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-1930s vintage snapshot showing a father or relative helping a small child balanced on a toy or tricycle in a garden allotment. Behind them is a tall wooden fence and a two-story brick residential building typical of mid-20th-century British urban architecture. The back features repeating diamond watermarks for Selo film paper, a famous British photographic paper brand by Ilford during the interwar era.
